#!/bin/bash -l
#$ -P welfgr
#$ -pe omp 4
#$ -l h_rt=00:30:00
#$ -l mem_per_core=4G
#$ -j y
set -euo pipefail
export TASK_ROOT=<scc-task>
module purge
module load gcc/12.2.0 python3/3.12.4
export CARGO_HOME=<scc-user>/fereg-rust-1.85.1/cargo
export RUSTUP_HOME=<scc-user>/fereg-rust-1.85.1/rustup
export RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=1.85.1
export PATH="$CARGO_HOME/bin:$PATH"
export CC=gcc CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 FEREG_TEST_THREADS=4
export FEREG_BUILD_DATE=2026-10-21 FEREG_GIT_COMMIT="$(python3 -c 'import json,os; from pathlib import Path; print(json.loads((Path(os.environ["TASK_ROOT"])/"gates-source.json").read_text())["fereg"][:12])')"
export CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$TASK_ROOT/build-gates-linux-cache"
export RUSTFLAGS="--remap-path-prefix=$TASK_ROOT=/build/cmg-upgrade --remap-path-prefix=<scc-user>=/build/user --remap-path-prefix=<scc-home>=/build/home"
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1
test ! -e "$CARGO_TARGET_DIR"
test ! -e "$TASK_ROOT/artifacts/Linux/policy-gates.plugin"
cd "$TASK_ROOT/sources/policy-gates"
verify_source() {
  python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json,os
from pathlib import Path
meta=json.loads((Path(os.environ['TASK_ROOT'])/'gates-source.json').read_text())
for name,digest in meta['source_files_sha256'].items():
    assert hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,name
PY
}
verify_source
./scripts/build_linux.sh
verify_source
cp dist/fereg_linux.plugin "$TASK_ROOT/artifacts/Linux/policy-gates.plugin"
sha256sum "$TASK_ROOT/artifacts/Linux/policy-gates.plugin"
printf 'POLICY_GATES_LINUX_BUILD_COMPLETE\n'

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
export TASK_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
export PATH="$TASK_ROOT/python/bin:<rust-1.85.1-bin>:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH"
export RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=1.85.1 FEREG_BUILD_DATE=2026-10-21
export FEREG_GIT_COMMIT="$(python3 -c 'import json,os; from pathlib import Path; print(json.loads((Path(os.environ["TASK_ROOT"])/"gates-source.json").read_text())["fereg"][:12])')" CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 FEREG_TEST_THREADS=4
export CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$TASK_ROOT/build-gates-mac-cache"
export RUSTFLAGS="--remap-path-prefix=<user-home>=/build/user --remap-path-prefix=$TASK_ROOT=/build/cmg-upgrade"
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1 VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=1
test ! -e "$CARGO_TARGET_DIR"
test ! -e "$TASK_ROOT/artifacts/Darwin/policy-gates.plugin"
cd "$TASK_ROOT/sources/policy-gates"
python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json,os,signal,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
meta=json.loads((Path(os.environ['TASK_ROOT'])/'gates-source.json').read_text())
def verify():
    for name,digest in meta['source_files_sha256'].items():
        assert hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,name
verify()
process=subprocess.Popen(['bash','scripts/build_macos.sh'],start_new_session=True)
try:
    rc=process.wait(timeout=1200)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
    os.killpg(process.pid,signal.SIGKILL)
    process.wait()
    raise
if rc:
    raise SystemExit(rc)
verify()
PY
cp dist/fereg_macos.plugin "$TASK_ROOT/artifacts/Darwin/policy-gates.plugin"
shasum -a 256 "$TASK_ROOT/artifacts/Darwin/policy-gates.plugin"
printf 'POLICY_GATES_MAC_BUILD_COMPLETE\n'

"""Bounded actual-plugin science integration on existing calibration inputs.

No performance score or model selection: 36 calls/platform, no retry, 120s/call.
This is separate from the untouched held-out and qualification panels.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,platform,sys,time

task=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repo=task.parents[2] if platform.system()=='Darwin' else task/'sources/policy-gates'
sys.path[:0]=[str(repo/'scripts'),str(repo/'bench')]
import qualify as q
import routing
import two_fe_policy_development as gates

started=time.monotonic()
system=platform.system(); plan_path=task/'policy'/f'plan-{system}.json'
plan=q.read(plan_path)
assert q.digest(task/'gates-source.json')=='729d0db9493b1c8526df605be14417034d29fbeb6d313b298409e264dec3ddd2'
source=q.read(task/'gates-source.json')
assert source['fereg']=='e9be9e64e4c0d3bed2de5434e756246eee9296c1'
assert q.read(task/'pivot-source.json')['fereg']==gates.INCUMBENT
candidate=task/'artifacts'/system/'policy-gates.plugin'
accepted=task/'artifacts'/system/'pivot-candidate.plugin'
harness=q.resolve(plan_path,plan['harness'])
assert len(sys.argv)==2 and len(sys.argv[1])==64
assert q.digest(candidate)==sys.argv[1], 'candidate differs from the actual audited build'
assert q.digest(accepted)=={'Darwin':'5e74381e1af6d3765563022d6077892e5c05e19084172cf452b1f2d739fbb21c','Linux':'55f94a87bc02cb7aa117a4c9445305cf9383ca272ea190bb8356aa112458ee32'}[system]
assert q.digest(harness)==plan['files'][plan['harness']]
output=task/'policy-gates'/f'integration-{system}'
output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
items=[next(c for c in plan['cases'] if c['id']==f's2026102201-{family}-{memory}')
       for family in ('high-degree-weak','wide-rhs','dense') for memory in ('fast','low')]
identities={str(p):q.digest(p) for p in (candidate,accepted,harness,plan_path,Path(__file__),task/'gates-source.json',task/'pivot-source.json')}
for item in items:
    for name in (item['input'],item['metadata'],item['oracle']['path'],item['oracle']['arrays']):
        path=q.resolve(plan_path,name)
        assert q.digest(path)==plan['files'][name],name
        identities[str(path)]=plan['files'][name]
for path in q.execution_sources().values():
    expected=source['source_files_sha256'][path.relative_to(repo).as_posix()]
    assert q.digest(path)==expected, path.name
    identities[str(path)]=expected
stamps={name:q.stamp(Path(name)) for name in identities}
record=dict(schema=1,status='running',source=source['fereg'],baseline=gates.INCUMBENT,
            purpose='Actual-plugin independent science, scoped compatibility, fixed-worker repeat and cross-worker gate/resource integration; command durations are not performance evidence.',
            platform=system,call_cap=36,per_call_timeout_s=120,total_budget_s=1200,
            identities=identities,execution_sources={n:q.digest(p) for n,p in q.execution_sources().items()},
            calls=[],cells=[],failures=[])
def save(): q.write(output/'summary.json',record)
def unchanged(): assert all(q.stamp(Path(n))==s for n,s in stamps.items())
first={}; saw_grant=saw_empty=False
save()
try:
    with q.Deadline(1200,started) as deadline:
        for item in items:
            meta=q.metadata(plan,item,plan_path)
            for workers in (1,4):
                cell=f"{item['id']}-t{workers}"; folder=output/cell; folder.mkdir()
                snapshots={}; signatures={}
                for role,artifact in (('accepted',accepted),('candidate',candidate),('repeat',candidate)):
                    unchanged(); assert len(record['calls'])<36
                    deadline.check()
                    request=folder/(role+'.case')
                    routing.prepare(q.resolve(plan_path,item['input']),request,'baseline' if role=='accepted' else routing.GATES,workers)
                    target=folder/(role+'.json'); log=folder/(role+'.log')
                    env=['env',*[v for key in q.ENVIRONMENT for v in ('-u',key)],*[key+'=1' for key in q.THREAD_ENV]]
                    if role!='accepted': env+=['FEREG_SOLVER_TRACE=1']
                    call=dict(cell=cell,role=role,input_sha256=q.digest(request),status='started')
                    record['calls'].append(call);save()
                    q.run_process([*env,str(harness),str(artifact),'--replay',str(request),str(target)],log,min(120,deadline.check()))
                    raw,columns,detail=q.read_native(target,log,meta)
                    call.update(log_sha256=q.digest(log),result_sha256=q.digest(target),columns_sha256=q.digest(columns),fingerprint=detail['fingerprint'],worker_signature=q.worker_signature(raw))
                    if role!='accepted':
                        resource=gates.resource_diagnostics(log.read_text(),'candidate',source['fereg'])
                        call.update(resource=resource,policy_signature=gates.semantic_signature(resource))
                        saw_grant |= any(e['grant']=='1' for e in resource['gate_events'])
                        saw_empty |= not resource['gate_events']
                    deadline.check();call['status']='passed'
                    snapshots[role]=(raw,columns,detail);signatures[role]=call
                    save()
                a,b,c=[snapshots[r] for r in ('accepted','candidate','repeat')]
                assert b[2]['fingerprint']==c[2]['fingerprint'], 'fixed-worker repeat'
                assert signatures['candidate']['policy_signature']==signatures['repeat']['policy_signature'], 'repeated policy trace'
                q.science.compatibility(a[0],b[0],a[1],b[1],meta,'auto',selected_policy=routing.policy(routing.PORTFOLIO_UNSEEDED))
                if item['id'] in first:
                    old,signature=first[item['id']]
                    q.cmgschur.scientific_comparison(old[0],b[0],old[1],b[1],meta)
                    assert signature==signatures['candidate']['policy_signature'], 'cross-worker policy trace'
                    assert q.worker_signature(old[0])==q.worker_signature(b[0]), 'cross-worker solver decisions'
                else: first[item['id']]=(b,signatures['candidate']['policy_signature'])
                record['cells'].append(dict(id=cell,science='passed',compatibility='passed',repeat='passed',cross_worker='passed' if workers==4 else 'reference'))
                save();print(cell,'PASS',flush=True)
        assert len(record['calls'])==36 and len(record['cells'])==12 and saw_grant and saw_empty
        unchanged();deadline.check();record.update(status='passed',elapsed_s=time.monotonic()-started,saw_grant=saw_grant,saw_no_episode=saw_empty)
        save();deadline.check()
except BaseException as error:
    record.update(status='failed',elapsed_s=time.monotonic()-started)
    record['failures'].append(dict(type=type(error).__name__,message=str(error)))
    save();raise
print('GATES_ACTUAL_NATIVE_INTEGRATION_PASS 36',flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
